final_answer:
Meta's revenue grew from $134,902M in FY2023 to $164,501M in FY2024, a growth rate of approximately 21.94% [DOC-1]. Amazon's net sales grew from $574,785M in FY2023 to $637,959M in FY2024, a growth rate of approximately 10.99% [DOC-1].

Note on comparability: Meta reports "revenue" while Amazon reports "net sales" — these are analogous top-line metrics but are labeled differently across the two companies' income statements, and the underlying business models (advertising vs. e-commerce/cloud) are not directly comparable in composition. With that caveat, both figures represent each company's total top-line growth for the same fiscal year period (FY2023–FY2024), so the percentage-point comparison is directionally valid.

Meta's growth rate (21.94%) exceeded Amazon's growth rate (10.99%) by approximately 10.95 percentage points.

ANSWER: Meta grew faster, by approximately 11 percentage points (21.9% vs. 11.0%).
